data.one_liner: Pure Dart implementation of the DES and Triple DES algorithms.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure Dart implementation of DES and Triple DES cryptographic algorithms. Supports ECB and CBC modes with configurable padding like PKCS5 and PKCS7.
use_when: You need to encrypt or decrypt data using DES or Triple DES in pure Dart.
You need compatibility with existing systems using pyDes or standard DES/3DES.
avoid_when: You need modern, highly secure encryption standards like AES.
You require hardware-accelerated cryptography for heavy workloads.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation with no external dependencies.
Supports multiple DES modes and padding types like PKCS5 and PKCS7.
weaknesses: Implements DES/Triple DES, which are considered cryptographically weak and legacy algorithms.
Not documented for platform-specific performance optimizations.

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need standard cryptographic hashes (like SHA or MD5) maintained by the Dart team.
